question: If my order is placed before the weekday cutoff, when should it arrive?
answer: Orders placed before 2 p.m. on a business day are dispatched that day. Standard delivery then takes 3–5 business days after dispatch.

references.text: Mosslamp Shop dispatches orders placed before 2 p.m. on a business day that same day. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days after dispatch. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding shop holidays.

question: How long do I have to return an unused item, and who pays return postage?
answer: You have 30 calendar days to return an unused item. The shop pays return postage for every return.

references.text: Unused items in their original packaging may be returned within 14 calendar days of delivery. Customers pay return postage unless the item arrived damaged or the shop sent the wrong item.

question: My order has not shipped. Can I cancel it, and when would I get my money back?
answer: Yes. You can cancel an order before dispatch by contacting shop support with your order number.
